# agentic-text

Send texts to opted-in contacts over Twilio, Telnyx, or Plivo.

Keywords: sms, twilio, 10dlc, agentic-suite, claude-code, codex, cli, mcp.

- SDK: import { dispatchText, createSmsAdapter } from "agentic-text".
- CLI: agentic-text send --to "..." --from "..." --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-text mcp, then call send_text.
- Prospects: send --prospect-file prospects.csv enforces basis, evidence_url, no_solicitation_flag, do_not_contact.
